description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended pembrolizumab, within its marketing authorisation, as an option with chemotherapy for neoadjuvant treatment and then continued alone as adjuvant treatment after surgery, for adults with triple-negative early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence or locally advanced breast cancer. Pembrolizumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
